unusable_reason: This video was filmed from the side, so knee and hip alignment can't be judged. Please film from the front, 2–3 m away, with the phone at hip height and your whole body, including both feet, in frame.
summary: Thanks for sending this. The camera is side-on, so we can't see whether your right knee drifts inward or whether your hips and trunk shift toward one side. Those checks need a front-on view. From the side, the squats look smooth and controlled, with good depth. Please re-record facing the camera so these points can be reviewed and discussed with your physio.
